description: This file defines a custom field class 'SugarFieldAssigned_user_name' for SuiteCRM, extending the base SugarField class. It primarily implements the 'getSearchViewSmarty' method to provide search view rendering logic for assigned user names, including handling for HTML return types.

classes.name: SugarFieldAssigned_user_name
classes.description: A custom field class extending SugarFieldBase, handling rendering of the assigned user name field in search views within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Method to generate the HTML content for search view of the assigned user name field, selecting different templates based on the function's 'returns' property.
